title: Trace the unledgered sound and write its entry
ask: A shipped sound has no provenance line. Trace it and write the entry, or recommend dropping it — the standing policy is to drop a restrictively-licensed or unprovenanced asset rather than work around its terms.
first_action: Trace the file through git history to the commit that added it, then write or recommend.
source_message: A shipped sound has no provenance line. Trace it and write the entry, or recommend dropping it — the standing policy is to drop a restrictively-licensed or unprovenanced asset rather than work around its terms.
result: Done in this session. assets/audio/sfx/nope.wav is our own sound: synthesized by tools/gen_sfx.py, added 2026-08-27 in the same commit as the refusal feedback it voices (7707b3a), reproducible byte-for-byte by rerunning the generator. Its CREDITS.md entry is written; no third-party rights exist and nothing needs dropping. The ledger's stale paragraph describing the deleted water_cc0 candidates was corrected in the same edit.
